finding.title: Do not convert unmeasured F6P-control E4P to a negative detection result
finding.description: The description says the F6P comparison yielded FBP/DHAP but no detected E4P. In Table III, the E4P cell under the F6P preparation is NBSP/blank, and the footnote defines blanks as not determined. The current assertion therefore invents a negative result. This does not change the independently supported SBP cleavage products or any mechanistic edge.
